# Seacoast Facility Services

> Owner-operated commercial window cleaning based in Exeter, New Hampshire, serving the NH Seacoast. Storefronts are most of the work, and most other commercial window jobs are taken after the job is looked at first. Prices are public and the website has an estimate tool that uses the same math as the invoice.

- Phone or text: (603) 583-9928
- Email: billing@seacoastfacilityservices.com
- Website: https://seacoastfacilityservices.com/
- Founded: September 2026 (Seacoast Facility Services LLC)

## Prices (as of November 2026)

- Standard window cleaning: $3 per pane, per side. A pane is one piece of glass in a frame. Sills and frames are wiped down with every clean at no extra charge.
- Glass doors: $5 per side.
- Hard water and mineral restoration: $20 per pane.
- Screen cleaning (removed, cleaned, re-hung): $5 each.
- Track and channel cleaning: $5 per window.
- Sticker, decal and paint removal: $5 to $15 per pane, priced on site.
- Minimum per visit on a recurring schedule: $50. Minimum for a one-time job: $75.
- Recurring discounts on the standard clean: weekly 20%, every 2 weeks 15%, monthly 10%.
- First-visit charge: +50% on the standard clean when the glass has not been cleaned by us in the last six months. Paid once: booking again within six months skips it, and weekly, bi-weekly and monthly schedules skip it entirely.
- Full price list: https://seacoastfacilityservices.com/pricing.txt

## Service area

Primary towns: Exeter, Stratham, Hampton, Portsmouth, Rye, Greenland, Newfields.
Extended area: Epping, Durham, Dover, Seabrook, North Hampton, Kensington.

## How it works

1. Get an estimate from the website's estimate tool, or call or text a glass count.
2. The details are confirmed and the customer is given a specific service week (not an exact appointment time).
3. The work is done that week. Recurring visits rebook automatically.

Online estimates are not final prices. The price is confirmed on site before work starts.
